confidence_notes: I based the food and drink anchors on web searches of cost-of-living aggregators and hotel bar menus. I converted prices at the pegged rate of about 1 OMR = 2.60 USD. Meals and coffee are fairly consistent across sources: cheap meals are about 2-2.5 OMR, cappuccino about 1.8-2.1 OMR and a mid-range meal for two about 15-18 OMR. Beer is less certain. Alcohol is sold mostly in licensed hotel bars and is heavily taxed, and source estimates range from about 2.5 to 6.75 OMR, so I used about 4.2 OMR for a draft beer. Cocktail and wine come from hotel bar menu ranges, about 5-8 OMR and 4-7 OMR per glass, so they reflect hotel bar prices. The accommodation figures are my own estimates from general knowledge, not from searches or listings. They are the least certain anchors because Muscat has very few registered hostels, so the dorm and private-room figures are rough. July is hot low season, which keeps hotel rates moderate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food prices are a little below Gulf peers such as Dubai and Doha. Alcohol prices match Gulf hotel-bar pricing. For accommodation I used a mid-cost Gulf capital in low season, cheaper than Dubai or Doha, with a thin hostel market like other Gulf cities.
